updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection at the network layer, preventing sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This enables organizations to detect risky user activity and enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policies at the network boundary.

updates.title: Purview Compliance Portal: Expanded Diagnostics Access to Additional Admin Roles
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview has expanded access to Diagnostics beyond Global Admin to include Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator, and Organization Management roles. This reduces reliance on Global Admin privileges and allows more role-based access to diagnostic functionality.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77903: Microsoft Dataverse Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Dataverse allows unauthorized attackers to spoof identities and elevate privileges over the network. Organizations using Dataverse should apply available security updates promptly.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69843: Microsoft Fabric Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability via spoofing in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. This affects access controls and identity verification in Fabric environments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85889: Azure AI Foundry Missing Authentication Vulnerability
updates.summary: Azure AI Foundry contains a missing authentication control for a critical function, allowing unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations should verify authentication is enforced for all critical operations in their AI Foundry deployments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69865: Microsoft Container Registry Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Container Registry is vulnerable to an authorization bypass through user-controlled keys, allowing unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. This affects container registry access controls and identity verification.

updates.title: Purview Data Loss Prevention: Upgraded Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is enhancing DLP inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed applications in Edge for Business with integration to Conditional Access grant controls, expanded policy conditions, multiple activities per rule, and improved visibility in activity explorer. This simplifies configuration while providing more granular control over data protection for managed applications.

updates.title: Purview Data Loss Prevention: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is extending DLP browser inline protection to a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI applications in Edge for Business, allowing administrators to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities. This provides consistent data security controls across more SaaS and AI destinations.

updates.title: Purview Data Loss Prevention: User-Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Purview is introducing user-based aggregation of DLP alerts, consolidating related alert events from multiple rule matches into a single alert object when a common user entity is involved. This feature reduces alert noise and simplifies investigation workflows for security teams.

updates.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Pre-Curated File Extension List for Policy Conditions
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now includes a pre-curated list of supported file extensions for the file extension condition, replacing manual free-form text entry. This prevents unsupported extensions from creating protection gaps and reduces unnecessary endpoint processing overhead.

updates.title: Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is consolidating all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into a single unified interface for discovery, creation, validation, and management. This streamlines the classifier management workflow across the platform.

updates.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Administrators can now use Purview retention policies to archive inactive SharePoint Online files to low-cost storage, extending data lifecycle management beyond keep/delete actions. This allows organizations to lower storage costs while maintaining compliance and data discoverability.

updates.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Insights and Policy Recommendations for Sensitive M365 Data
updates.summary: Purview DLM now provides insights on sensitive data in OneDrive and SharePoint, along with recommendations for retention policies to better govern sensitive information. This helps organizations improve their data security and compliance posture through guided policy recommendations.

updates.title: Purview Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations Integration
updates.summary: Data security admins can now launch pre-scoped Data Security Investigations directly from an Insider Risk Management case to perform deeper investigation and content analysis on risky users. This integration improves post-incident data impact assessment and investigation efficiency.

updates.title: Purview Insider Risk Management: Collection Policies Impact Support
updates.summary: Purview Insider Risk Management now supports collection policies that allow admins to scope classification (Sensitive Information Types) and activities for specific users. Admins should review collection policies across different Purview solution administrators to ensure they detect activities required by IRM policies.

updates.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Teams Retention Policies Scoped Away from Copilot
updates.summary: Legacy Teams-only retention policies that currently apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads. Organizations should review and update retention policies to separately define governance for Copilot interactions.

updates.title: CVE-2026-68791: Azure Machine Learning Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
updates.summary: Azure Machine Learning contains an incorrect authorization control that allows unauthorized attackers to disclose information over the network. Organizations should apply security updates to prevent information exposure from AML resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85878: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
updates.summary: Azure Database for PostgreSQL contains an improper authorization flaw allowing authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Administrators should audit access controls and apply available security updates.
